title: execution-profiles registry
description: coh-id-04 identity registry: the built service image digests per execution profile. The image index digest is present only when a multi-platform manifest list was published; a single-platform build records per-profile platform manifest digests only.

image.description: Image reference the digests belong to (registry path or local tag).

image_index_digest.description: Digest of the multi-platform manifest list, when one exists.

base_image.description: Base image pinned by index digest at build time.
